Theatre Nerves-4

This instrument is composed of four statements about the stage.  Please indicate the degree to which each statement applies to you by marking whether you:

Strongly Disagree	Disagree	Neutral	Agree	Strongly Agree
             1	    	      2 	 	     3 		    4 		           5

_____1. I shake before going on stage.

_____2. I forget my lines.

_____3. I avoid auditions.

_____4. I feel sick in the wings.

Scoring:  To compute your scores, add your scores for each item as indicated below:

After you have recoded the previous questions, follow the following to see your composite Theatre Nerves score

Add questions 1-2 for your basic Body Score		________

Add questions 3-4 for your basic Avoidance Score		________

Add the two subscales together to get your Overall Stage Fright Score	________
